?

The only description of what’s coming upon you shall be BEAUTY -Part 5

1 Samuel 16:19 So Saul sent messengers to Jesse requesting, “Send your son David to me, the one who tends the sheep.”
1 Samuel 16:21 David came to Saul and stood before him. Saul liked him immediately and made him his right-hand man.
1 Samuel 16:22 Saul sent word back to Jesse: “Thank you. David will stay here. He’s just the one I was looking for. I’m very impressed by him.”
?
Yesterday, we talked about how king Saul’s servant spoke up & spoke well of David..

?Everything the servant told the king could only be summed up in one word…BEAUTIFUL.

?The servant’s description of David was so captivating that the king ordered that David be brought before him.

?When David appeared before the king, his status, his Resume, his relevance, his location all changed immediately.
?
By the Grace of God upon you..
You will be summoned to high places.✔
You will be given a new position and title.✔
They will find you too relevant and irresistible to let you go.✔

?Everyone that sets eyes upon you will favour you in Jesus name.✔
????????
